findings.acceptance_test: With only synthetic metadata, require exact JSON booleans for verdicts and finite bounded numeric evidence in the declared schema. Nonboolean verdicts and invalid numeric values must fail before output; valid negative verdicts must remain negative.
findings.detail: Input validation requires three evidence fields to exist but does not validate their value types or domains. Two verdict fields are converted using truthiness, and the numeric field is copied unchanged. A nonempty false-like string therefore becomes a positive declared verdict.
findings.impact_inference: Malformed upstream evidence can produce an overstated manifest declaration. Current downstream publication enforcement and any actual scientific or runtime outcome remain unknown.
findings.title: Manifest verdicts coerce malformed evidence into positive declarations

findings.acceptance_test: Use a synthetic matching digest in an incomplete statement with no subject name or predicate. Require an explicit structural-validation failure while keeping a complete benign statement as a separate valid case; do not promote either case into authorization.
findings.detail: The verifier checks the statement type, optionally checks predicate type, then accepts matching subject-digest membership. It does not invoke maintained structural validation or require a subject name and nonempty predicate. Those fields are required in the reviewed construction path.
findings.impact_inference: The result described as a valid statement can exceed a digest-membership observation. Digest equality remains separate from cryptographic validity, signer trust and release authorization.
findings.title: Statement digest membership can pass without structural validity

findings.acceptance_test: Supply only synthetic subjects with null, list and scalar digest values. Each must return a fixed false result without an exception or echoed input value.
findings.detail: For each dictionary subject, the verifier calls a mapping method on its digest value without checking that value's type. A present null or other nonmapping digest can therefore raise instead of returning the documented graceful failure.
findings.impact_inference: A malformed input can interrupt a receipt consumer that relies on the stated never-raises validation contract. No live service failure was observed.
findings.title: Malformed subject digest breaks the statement verifier's fail-soft contract

findings.acceptance_test: Construct a synthetic receipt from nested caller-owned data and mutate the original and exposed body. Require a documented immutable snapshot or explicit mutable contract; when signing is tested by its owner, all advertised digest, payload and signature must derive from the same captured bytes.
findings.detail: The documented immutable record is an unfrozen dataclass retaining a mutable body dictionary. Digest computation reads that live dictionary. Signing separately reads the body for the digest, envelope payload and signature rather than using one captured byte snapshot.
findings.impact_inference: Caller or concurrent mutation can change a receipt's evidence after construction or make signing steps describe different snapshots. The reviewed exact-byte verifier may reject such inconsistencies; no false cryptographic PASS or live failure is asserted.
findings.title: Receipt representation is mutable despite its immutable-record contract

findings.acceptance_test: Compare both representations against the existing benign fixed-byte format fixture. Require exact byte agreement and a failed conformance result for the conflicting representation. Do not treat self-parsing as independent interoperability proof.
findings.detail: The runner length-prefixes the context as well as payload type and payload. The reviewed fixed-format tests assert a literal context prefix instead. The V02 check builds and reparses the runner's own representation, so it does not independently resolve this cross-file contradiction.
findings.impact_inference: V02 can establish local self-consistency while leaving the incompatible fixed-format assertions unresolved. External-spec correctness, the referenced canonical implementation and deployed interoperability remain unverified.
findings.title: Conformance PAE representation contradicts the reviewed fixed-format tests

findings.acceptance_test: Use benign synthetic vector metadata. Reject unrecognized expectations before checks run, reject duplicate IDs, and reject an incomplete set when claiming the full documented suite. Report observed versus required coverage explicitly.
findings.detail: The runner requires a nonempty vector directory but does not enforce the documented five-vector identity set or unique IDs. It does not validate the expectation enum; any unrecognized expectation is handled as a negative expectation, allowing a failed check to be reported as a passed vector.
findings.impact_inference: Malformed vector metadata can cause a false vector PASS, and a successful incomplete run does not establish complete five-vector coverage. Any separate caller coverage enforcement remains outside this scope.
findings.title: Malformed expectations and incomplete vector sets can produce an all-pass declaration

findings.acceptance_test: With synthetic local receipt metadata, combine a supplied predecessor with a genesis sentinel and require an explicit linkage failure or separately documented genesis-only result. A missing required predecessor must fail required conformance.
findings.detail: The linkage check accepts the genesis sentinel before comparing an explicitly supplied predecessor. The vector's declared purpose requires comparison when a predecessor is supplied. The timestamp check reads predecessor time only when its path exists.
findings.impact_inference: The suite can accept incomplete predecessor evidence in this branch. This does not establish a deployed chain bypass or release authorization failure.
findings.title: Genesis handling bypasses a supplied predecessor requirement

findings.acceptance_test: Use a benign synthetic predecessor fixture whose path replacement is controlled by the test harness. Require both checks to consume one bounded captured byte snapshot with one recorded digest, or explicitly fail a detected replacement.
findings.detail: The linkage check hashes one read of the predecessor file, while the timestamp check independently rereads the same path. The checks do not share a captured predecessor byte snapshot in the reviewed implementation.
findings.impact_inference: If the local file changes between checks, the combined result can refer to different predecessor evidence. No changing-file incident was observed.
findings.title: Predecessor digest and timestamp use separate local reads

findings.acceptance_test: PROPOSAL: Use synthetic review/merge markers and a generic AI mention without an authorship marker; the result must not describe all three explicit markers as present and must retain missing authorship evidence.
findings.detail: The visible fallback creates an authorship note from an unmarked AI mention. With review and merge markers, dictionary-entry counting can reach the branch describing all three vocabulary markers as present. The taxonomy requires all three explicit markers. Existing visible tests supply all three markers and do not establish fallback behavior. No parser was executed.
findings.title: Fallback note can be counted as a required authorship marker

findings.acceptance_test: PROPOSAL: Use a generic unavailable-review statement explicitly denying approval; establish the intended diagnostic behavior and ensure denial alone is not reported as an affirmative approval claim.

findings.acceptance_test: PROPOSAL: Use inert data with signed=true and an empty signatures array or an empty entry; a shape-only result must not become verified-signature or admissible-evidence status.

Top-level envelope fields are also outside the receipt's required list. These are shape-contract observations; signature verification behavior remains UNKNOWN.
findings.title: DSSE prose requirements are not visible signature-verification evidence

findings.title: Policy reference shape does not establish immutable policy bytes

findings.acceptance_test: NOT_RUN proposal: use a benign synthetic signed read-only listing receipt without a supplied trust key; require an explicit signature SKIPPED or UNVERIFIED state and keep structural validity separately labeled.
findings.detail: When signatures are present but no verify key is supplied, check_signatures returns a successful boolean with a SKIP explanation. The report formatter consequently prefixes this check with PASS. Aggregate file and overall results can also remain PASS. The source documentation says skipped signature checks must never be reported as a pass. A reader or status parser can treat PASS as successful cryptographic verification even though the key was absent. The explanation discloses the skip, but the leading status conflicts with that explanation. No live invocation or consumer behavior was observed.

findings.acceptance_test: NOT_RUN proposal: a benign synthetic read-only listing receipt declares both digest formats; alter only the raw-payload digest and require an explicit contradictory-digest failure.
findings.detail: The content-hash checker returns immediately after validating a declared PAE digest. A simultaneously declared raw-payload digest is therefore not compared. Both digest names are accepted by the envelope metadata allowlist. A receipt carrying a correct PAE digest and a contradictory raw-payload digest can avoid rejection of the second declared digest by this source control flow. This is a conditional static result; no fixture was executed.

findings.acceptance_test: NOT_RUN proposal: an inert read-only scanner fixture emits no stdout and an error exit status; require an explicit gate error. Separately preserve success for the ordinary no-match exit status.
findings.detail: Both search stages suppress every nonzero exit status with an unconditional successful fallback. The final success branch checks only whether filtered stdout is empty. A missing scanner, search failure, or read error with no matching stdout can take the same success path as an ordinary no-match result. No scanner failure was observed at runtime.

A filename containing an exemption term can suppress matching content that contains no guard or prohibition context, exceeding the same-source-line exemption described by the workflow. findings.acceptance_test: NOT_RUN proposal: use inert synthetic workflow text with required binding strings confined to comments and an active read-only listing job using a different source reference; require the contract check to reject it.
findings.detail: The regression checks for five required substrings anywhere in each workflow text. It does not bind them to active job environment values, checkout inputs, or executable proof steps. Required text confined to comments or disconnected steps can satisfy these assertions while active binding differs. The three reviewed workflow files currently contain visibly connected source-binding steps; this finding concerns future regression strength.

findings.acceptance_test: PROPOSAL, NOT_RUN: an inert environment-receipt fixture with absent image/version/dependency provenance must remain incomplete; only an exact-head receipt identifying actual runtime and resolved versions can support an exact-environment claim. No workflow settings or builds are changed by this audit.
findings.detail: The visible workflow selects ubuntu-latest, minor Python labels and an editable dev install. Its action references are full commit pins, but these workflow statements do not supply an immutable runner-image digest or an observed resolved dependency receipt. Packaging/lock contents are outside this batch, so dependency compatibility and installation behavior remain UNKNOWN.
findings.impact_inference: A successful run label alone cannot establish exact-environment reproducibility without separately bound runtime/environment evidence.
findings.title: CI source does not bind the runner image or resolved install environment
